descriptionChirho: A state of lacking or being deficient in something needed, whether material or spiritual. The multilingual evidence uniformly points to a single concept: spa 'carencia/falta', hin 'ghati/kami' (shortage), arb 'nuqsan' (deficiency), kor 'bujokham' (insufficiency), swa 'upungufu/uhaba' (shortage). The plural forms (S78306 'lacks', S78308 'needs') and singular forms (S78305 'lack') represent the same lexical sense across all grammatical cases (N-ANS, N-GNS, N-ANP), with no semantic distinction emerging from the translation signatures.
